changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE pkg_packaging_submission ( id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_pkg_packaging_submission PRIMARY KEY, organisation_id uuid NOT NULL, packaging_year integer NOT NULL, -- The registration year this data is reported before: packaging_year + 1, the same rule as -- period_packaging_submission_period.registration_year. A year, not a registration id: producers -- report packaging data before they register. registration_year integer NOT NULL, status varchar(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_pkg_packaging_submission_status CHECK (status IN ('Draft', 'Submitted')), created_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL );
CREATE INDEX ix_pkg_packaging_submission_organisation_year ON pkg_packaging_submission (organisation_id, packaging_year);
